subject: MAP: Helix evaluation - procurement backstop & soft-lock request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@helixhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Helix evaluation - procurement backstop & soft-lock request

Alex / Procurement team —

Quick note as we head into the new year: based on your update yesterday that the internal security committee will not clear the contract until the 2nd week of January, we need to align on a short MAP rebaseline and a procurement backstop to protect the planned go-live window. Current close date on our side is 2028-01-20; with the procurement delay that slips to the right unless we agree a soft-lock / provisional setup.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Redwood proposes a 2-week soft-lock: we reserve the requested Dedicated pool and model slot for Helix until 2028-01-06 (no charges) if procurement provides a signed Letter of Intent or an approved PO commitment by EOD 2028-01-05.
- If we receive a formal PO but contract redlines are outstanding, we will proceed with a canary migration under NDA and SOC2-limited data scope to preserve timeline.
- Attach: HLX_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with checkpoint dates), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf, redwood-terms-diff.docx.

Please confirm whether Procurement can commit to the LOI/PO path by 2028-01-05 or share an updated internal approval date. Happy to hop on a quick call (15–20m) Monday to walk the MAP.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

--
Attachment stubs: HLX_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (pdf), redwood-terms-diff.docx (docx)

From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@helixhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Dec 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Helix evaluation - procurement backstop & soft-lock request

Hannah —

Appreciate the heads-up and clear actions. Short answer: the security committee pause impacts legal signoff too; we are targeting an internal procurement resolution by 2028-01-10 at the earliest. I will try to accelerate but can't promise the 01/05 LOI cadence.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood confirm the exact scope of the "canary migration under NDA" (what features/data are permitted)?
2) If we provide a PO with standard redlines (payment + data handling), will you accept that as a provisional commitment for the soft-lock?

Happy to do a 15m call Monday morning PST to align.

Thanks —
Alex Taylor
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helix Health
alex.taylor@helixhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Jan 2028 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: HLX soft-lock escalation recommendation

Hannah / Lauren —

Based on Alex's note, procurement won't meet our 01/05 LOI deadline. Quick internal recommendation set I plan to present to Revenue Operations and Finance if we need to escalate:

1) Offer a conditional soft-lock to 2028-01-12 with a refundable reservation fee of $5k to hold the Dedicated pool. If Helix signs PO within that window, fee credited to first month.
2) Accept PO-as-provisional if accompanied by corporate purchase card transaction reference (to reduce legal exposure).
3) Prepare a stripped-down canary runbook (data pseudonymization + no PHI) to propose to their security team; include SOC2 mini-checklist (we already attached summary).

I'll draft the fee/terms language and share a redlined proposal for Hannah to send. If you want me on the call with Alex, say the word.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

--
Attachment stub: procurement-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Jan 2028 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Helix evaluation - procurement backstop & soft-lock request

Hannah / Team —

Thanks for the plan. Quick clarifications from Procurement: we can provide an internal PO by 2028-01-06 only if (a) contract commercial terms are materially unchanged, and (b) the SOC2-limited canary scope is documented and acceptable to Security. Legal will not sign off on provisional acceptance language that leaves open open-amount exposure.

What we can offer instead:
- A conditional PO for the estimated first-month consumption (cap at $25k) with a defined clawback clause if final contract is not executed by 2028-01-20.
- A procurement contact (Maya Singh) will own the PO flow; please confirm the final MAP checkpoint dates and an explicit canary runbook.

Procurement will join a 15m call on 2028-01-05 at 10:00 PST if Redwood can provide the runbook and redlined terms before the call.

Procurement Team
Helix Health
procurement@helixhealth.com

To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@helixhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jan 2028 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Helix evaluation - procurement backstop & soft-lock request

Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks for the fast responses and the clarity on constraints. Confirming next steps and sender-visible escalation path so everyone has the same read: 

What Redwood will do now:
- Draft a 2-page canary runbook (pseudonymized test set, no PHI, read-only logs) and circulate by 2028-01-04 EOD.
- Offer the conditional PO acceptance path outlined by Procurement (cap at $25k / clawback) and formalize the refundable reservation fee option for the Sales Ops review.
- Push a short redline that limits exposure (payment holdback + 30-day final-sign window). Ben will circulate the fee language by EOD 2028-01-03.

Ask of Helix: please confirm Maya Singh as procurement owner and commit to the 10:00 PST call on 2028-01-05. If Helix can provide the provisional PO or LOI before the call, Redwood will mark the Dedicated pool as reserved through 2028-01-12 while legal clears final terms.

Risk log summary (top 3):
1) Procurement delay -> go-live slips beyond 2028-01-20. Mitigation: PO-backstop + refundable reservation.
2) Security committee requires additional evidence -> mitigation: canary runbook + SOC2 checklist (attached).
3) Contract redlines escalate -> mitigation: accept PO-as-provisional + legal clawback language.

I'll send the MAP v2 with checkpoint updates and the runbook draft attached. If Procurement needs exec-level signoff to accelerate, I can escalate to our VP of Sales Operations; please flag.

Best —
Hannah
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
